Sound effects (CC0 1.0) from OpenGameArt.org:
- 100 CC0 SFX, 100 CC0 SFX #2, 80 CC0 creature SFX (rubberduck) https://opengameart.org
- Horror Hit Soundpack 1 https://opengameart.org/content/horror-hit-soundpack-1
Voices performed with Chatterbox by Resemble AI (MIT) https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox
  cloning reference voices made with Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
Fonts: Special Elite (Apache-2.0), VT323 (OFL) via Google Fonts.
Characters: Quaternius Ultimate Modular Men & Women (CC0).
Mutant1 creature: from the developer's own asset library (LastLight project).
